about:
SouthEastern Solar, Inc is based in Alabaster, Alabama. The company was founded with the mission to provide clients with quality reliable solar equipment at value prices through user-friendly engineering design and professional installation service.

The firm designs and installs roof-mounted and ground-mounted photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, and solar-farm applications. Its services include 24/7 emergency support, free site evaluations, and a proprietary Solar Estimator tool that helps customers size their systems.

SouthEastern Solar serves customers across multiple sectors, including agriculture, schools and education, healthcare, office, public sector, logistics and transport, religious and non-profit organizations, retail and wholesale, and leisure. For residential and off-grid projects, the company covers Bibb, Blount, Jefferson, Shelby, St. Clair, Tuscaloosa, and Walker counties in Alabama. Commercial and industrial installations are offered throughout Alabama, the Florida Panhandle, Georgia, Mississippi, and Tennessee.

The company emphasizes affordable, reliable, efficient, and quiet systems powered by free sunlight. Financing options are available through banks, mortgage companies, power purchase agreements, and manufacturers. SouthEastern Solar was started to deliver quality solar equipment at value prices, backed by engineering design and installation expertise.
